versions.changelog:
- Initial release: Open Docker website in the user's Brave browser.
- Reuses existing Docker tab/session when possible to avoid duplicates.
- Verifies site load and ensures correct destination before confirming success.
- Uses existing authenticated browser session; stops at login page if authentication is required.
- Does not perform any modification actions unless explicitly instructed.
- Only opens and verifies the website, without downloading or deploying content.
